user.title: Add Bose device
user.description: Choose how the Bose device should be added and whether you want a quick or expert setup.

discover.title: Discover Bose device
discover.description: Choose one of the discovered Bose devices. You can adjust the displayed device name before continuing.

manual.title: Add Bose device manually
manual.description: Enter the basic Bose device details first. Routing and presets are configured in the next steps.

routing.title: Choose routing
routing.description: Decide whether only the Bose player should be created, whether presets should play directly on the Bose via UPNP, or whether they should be routed to another player.

routing_player.title: Choose target player
routing_player.description: Select the Music Assistant or Home Assistant media player that Bose presets should be routed to.

presets.title: Configure presets
presets.description: Enter a stream URL for each preset button you want to use. Presets with a URL are automatically stored on the Bose device so physical button presses are detected.

advanced.title: Advanced options
advanced.description: Adjust the optional start volume and other advanced values that are not required for a quick setup.

summary.title: Check summary

reconfigure.title: Edit Bose device
reconfigure.description: Choose whether you want to edit the device with the quick or expert setup.

reconfigure_device.title: Edit Bose device details
reconfigure_device.description: Adjust the Bose device name and IP address.

reconfigure_routing.title: Edit routing
reconfigure_routing.description: Adjust whether the Bose device should only exist as a player, play presets directly via UPNP, or route presets to another player.

reconfigure_routing_player.title: Edit target player
reconfigure_routing_player.description: Select the Music Assistant or Home Assistant media player that Bose presets should be routed to.

reconfigure_presets.title: Edit presets
reconfigure_presets.description: Update stream URLs for preset buttons. Presets with a URL are automatically stored on the Bose device so physical button presses are detected.

reconfigure_advanced.title: Edit advanced options
reconfigure_advanced.description: Adjust optional advanced values for this Bose device.

reconfigure_summary.title: Check summary
